audience.text: Developers building .NET services, desktop tools, or CLI utilities that need to read, create, convert, or inspect Outlook MSG, CFB, and EML data without requiring Microsoft Outlook or third-party packages.

capabilities.text: Load MSG files from streams or paths using MapiMessage.FromStream or FromFile, and save messages using Save methods.
capabilities.title: Read and write MSG files

capabilities.text: Build new messages with MapiMessage.Create, set sender, recipients, body, and attachments, then persist to disk.
capabilities.title: Create messages programmatically

capabilities.text: Parse EML files into MapiMessage objects using LoadFromEml and serialize back to EML using SaveToEml natively.
capabilities.title: Convert between MSG and EML

capabilities.text: Open CFB files with CfbReader and traverse directory trees using IterTree, IterStorages, and IterStreams.
capabilities.title: Inspect CFB containers

capabilities.text: Set and retrieve low-level MAPI properties via SetProperty and GetPropertyValue beyond strongly-typed members.
capabilities.title: Access arbitrary MAPI properties

capabilities.text: Add recipients and attachments—including embedded messages—using AddRecipient and AddAttachment methods.
capabilities.title: Attach recipients and files

limitations.text: No IMAP, SMTP, or POP3 support; the library only processes local files and does not connect to mail servers.
No TNEF (winmail.dat) support; the library does not parse or generate Transport Neutral Encapsulation Format.
No dedicated calendar or appointment API; calendar-specific MAPI properties can only be accessed generically.
Requires .NET 8.0 or later; classic .NET Framework (4.x) is not supported.

problems_solved.text: Enables deterministic parsing and generation of Outlook MSG files and CFB containers without external dependencies or Microsoft Outlook installation.
Supports native round-trip conversion between MSG and EML formats without requiring external MIME parsers.
Provides low-level access to CFB structure for forensic inspection or repair of malformed MSG files.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Email FOSS for .NET is a free, open-source .NET 8.0+ library for deterministic processing of Outlook MSG files, Compound File Binary (CFB) containers, and EML messages with no external dependencies.

workflows.name: Read MSG subject
workflows.text: Open an MSG file stream and load it with MapiMessage.FromStream to access message properties like Subject.

workflows.name: Create and save MSG
workflows.text: Create a MapiMessage programmatically, set sender, recipients, body, and attachments, then save to disk as MSG.

workflows.name: Convert EML to MSG
workflows.text: Load an EML file using MapiMessage.LoadFromEml and persist it as MSG using Save, then regenerate EML with SaveToEml.

workflows.name: Inspect CFB structure
workflows.text: Use CfbReader.FromFile to open a MSG file and traverse its directory tree to inspect sector size and entry hierarchy.
